  SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_api_id = 6351 AND home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as home_wins,
  SUM(CASE WHEN away_team_api_id = 6351 AND away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as away_wins
FROM Match
WHERE league_id = 1
